title: Remove a Visible Seedance Watermark from an Image
description: Process a Seedance image or extracted video frame you own or may edit. Current preview processing returns an unchanged copy.
heading: Clean visible Seedance marks from authorized images
intro: Use the private image workflow for a Seedance still or extracted frame. Direct video processing and invisible provenance removal are outside the current MVP.

process.heading: Check, upload, and review a visible Seedance mark

steps.title: Choose authorized media
steps.description: Select a JPG, PNG, or WebP image you own or have permission to modify, up to 10 MB.

steps.title: Upload to private storage
steps.description: Sign in with Google and send the image directly to private object storage for the processing workflow.

steps.title: Inspect the returned preview
steps.description: Compare the separate result with your source; the current MVP provider returns an unchanged copy.

faq.heading: What to know before removing a visible Seedance watermark

items.question: Can I upload a Seedance video?
items.answer: No. The current tool accepts one JPG, PNG, or WebP image up to 10 MB. Export a frame first if you need to test the workflow.

items.question: Does it remove the mark today?
items.answer: Not yet. The preview provider currently returns an unchanged copy while production processing is integrated.

items.question: Are files private?
items.answer: Files use private object storage and are scheduled for deletion after 24 hours.

items.question: What may I process?
items.answer: Only process media you own or have permission to modify.
